review_policy.label_error_meaning: The scoped present/not_observed assessment is not supported by the supplied pseudo-C.
review_policy.evidence_error_meaning: The target finding does not expose the target-CWE relation needed to teach or justify the assessment.

decisions.notes: CWE-121 not_observed target cites the 49-byte source initialization but omits a destination boundary tied to the subsequent copy.
CWE-121 not_observed target again cites the reduced source only; it does not expose the copy sink and destination capacity relation.
CWE-122 not_observed target cites wmemset(..., 0x31) and a terminator but omits the heap destination and swprintf/copy operation.
CWE-457 not_observed target cites control-flow loops and a read but omits the per-element initialization needed to justify the label.
CWE-457 not_observed target contains only printIntLine on a recovered pointer expression and exposes no initialization.
CWE-122 not_observed target cites only the 49-byte source initialization and terminator; the heap destination and snprintf sink are absent.
